messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall: high error rate detected for hosted inference API (text-generation). 503 spikes starting at 1961234500. Severity: P1. Page: maria.

maria: on it. grabbing logs & checking recent deploys. any hints on region?

dave: seeing elevated 5xx from the inference gateway in us-east-1. spike around 1961234400. redis errors + queue backlog. attaching quick tail:

jordan: paste logs? I saw a burst of large sequences earlier from a customer load test, might be KV cache pressure.

dave: log snippet:
```
ERROR handler.go:217 request_id=abc123 upstream=nv-infer-01 status=503 reason="kv-cache-timeout" latency=1203ms
WARNING cache.go:88 evict backlog=512 active=230
```

maria: thanks. rolling mitigations: 1) scale inference pool by +2 nodes in us-east-1 2) route lower-tier traffic to fallback model variant 3) enable shorter kv cache TTL temporarily. will coordinate.

ravindra: we need a status page initial update ASAP. draft below — please review for accuracy and scope.

amanda: drop edits inline.

ravindra: STATUS PAGE DRAFT (initial):
```
We are investigating an elevated rate of 503 errors affecting text-generation requests in the us-east-1 hosted region. Some requests may fail or experience increased latency. Engineers are actively investigating and applying mitigations. We will post updates every 10-15 minutes or as we have significant changes.
Impact: Some customers and production traffic in us-east-1 may see failed generation requests or higher latency.
```

elaine: good short description. can we quantify impact for customers? even ballpark percent of traffic?

dave: quick estimate from metrics: ~12% of requests in us-east-1 show 5xx, regional traffic ~25% of total so overall ~3% of global requests affected. not sure about customer counts.

ravindra: updated draft with numbers:
```
We are investigating an elevated rate of 503 errors affecting text-generation requests in the us-east-1 hosted region. Approximately 12% of requests in that region and roughly 3% of global requests may see failed generation or increased latency.
```

maria: legal-bot, any red flags for wording?

legal-bot: quick check: avoid implying data loss or exposure. "Investigating" + concrete numbers ok. keep it factual.

amanda: minor phrasing nit: change "may see failed generation" -> "may experience failed requests or increased latency"

ravindra: final PR-ready draft below. please +1 if ok.
```
We are investigating an elevated rate of 503 errors affecting text-generation requests in the us-east-1 hosted region. Approximately 12% of requests in that region (roughly 3% of global requests) may experience failed requests or increased latency. Engineers are actively investigating root cause and applying mitigations, including scaling inference pools and routing lower-priority traffic to fallback variants. We will post updates every ~15 minutes or as significant progress is made.
```

jordan: +1

dave: +1 (scaling in progress, I also started a safety rollback on the last deploy in us-east-1 just in case)

maria: +1. publishing in 30s unless objections. publishing will set incident status: investigating.

ravindra: please include the follow-up update text for the first periodic update (30m): draft:
```
Update (30m): Scaling and routing mitigations applied. The rate of 503 errors has dropped from ~12% to ~4% in us-east-1. Some customers may still see transient failures. Engineers continue to monitor and validate. Estimated time to resolution: TBD.
```

elaine: we should avoid ETA unless we have one. change "Estimated time to resolution" -> "No ETA at this time."

ravindra: updated.
```
Update (30m): Scaling and routing mitigations applied. The rate of 503 errors has dropped from ~12% to ~4% in us-east-1. Some customers may still see transient failures. Engineers continue to monitor and validate. No ETA at this time.
```

amanda: +1

legal-bot: okay to publish.

maria: publishing now.

statuspage-bot: :loudspeaker: Status page update published (incident #INC-1961) — State: Investigating.

ravindra: thanks. I'll thread a short customer-facing email template for support to use:
```
Subject: Temporary API errors in us-east-1 (we're on it)
Body: We're investigating increased 503 errors for text-generation requests in us-east-1. Some requests may fail or see higher latency. Our engineers are applying mitigations now. We'll follow up when we have additional updates or a resolution. For urgent impact, reply and include your request IDs.
```

amanda: copying to support channel and ops runbook.

-- 35 minutes later --

incident-bot: periodic update: metrics reported at 1961234702.

maria: Update: after scaling + routing, 5xx rate steady ~3.8% in us-east-1. root cause signal points to unexpected KV cache pressure driven by large sequences from a single customer job. working on a targeted throttle and cache sizing tweak.

dave: applied cache TTL drop and increased cache capacity; monitoring.

ravindra: draft periodic status update:
```
Update (55m): Scaling and routing mitigations remain in effect. The 503 error rate has decreased to ~3.8% in us-east-1. A single customer's high-sequence workload appears to be a major contributor; we are applying targeted throttling and cache size changes. We will post another update in 30 minutes or when there's significant change.
```

elaine: +1

amanda: +1

maria: publishing update now.

statuspage-bot: :loudspeaker: Status page update published (incident #INC-1961) — Update: decreased error rates.

-- 1 hour 45 minutes after start --

dave: as of 1961236300, error rates returned to baseline ~0.1%. I initiated traffic normalization and removed temporary throttles.

maria: running final checks on replayed mux streams and long-tail requests. nothing else flagged.

ravindra: DRAFT RESOLVED NOTICE:
```
Resolved: The elevated rate of 503 errors affecting text-generation in us-east-1 has been resolved. Error rates have returned to normal and mitigations (scaling, routing, and cache adjustments) have been removed. We will perform a follow-up post-incident review and share findings with customers if there are substantive takeaways. If you continue to experience issues, please open a support ticket and include request IDs.
```

elaine: suggest adding timestamp and link to post-incident review doc once ready.

ravindra: updated resolved notice to include follow-up note.
```
Resolved: The elevated rate of 503 errors affecting text-generation in us-east-1 has been resolved as of 1961236300. Error rates have returned to normal and mitigations (scaling, routing, and cache adjustments) have been removed. A post-incident review will be published and linked here when available. If you continue to experience issues, please open a support ticket and include request IDs.
```

amanda: +1

dave: +1

maria: publishing resolved notice.

statuspage-bot: :white_check_mark: Status page update published (incident #INC-1961) — State: Resolved.

ravindra: filing postmortem plan and action items in the incidents folder. thanks everyone for fast responses. :pray:
